title: Engineering Manager, Billing
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the Billing team at Supabase. Billing owns the monetization and revenue systems that turn platform usage into accurate customer charges and finance-ready revenue data. The team’s scope includes plans, subscriptions, usage-based billing, invoices, payments, credits, coupons, taxation, dunning, collections, pricing mechanics, entitlements, marketplace and partner billing paths, and integrations with providers such as Stripe and Orb.

Billing sits at the intersection of engineering, product, finance, data, support, and partnerships. The systems are revenue-critical and trust-critical: they must remain correct, predictable, supportable, observable, and extensible as Supabase grows and introduces new products, pricing models, and partner channels.

This is a people, delivery, and technical leadership role. We don’t expect managers to contribute production code directly, but we do expect you to participate in architecture and design discussions, challenge plans with sound technical reasoning, and set a high bar for correctness, reliability, and operational maturity.

WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

Team & People

- Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

- Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

- Coach engineers working across backend application code, data pipelines, external integrations, and operational workflows.

- Build durable ownership across the team so critical billing knowledge, access, and incident response do not depend on one person.

- Handle people administration, including leave and time off, for your team.

Hiring

- Own the hiring plan for the Billing team and act as Hiring Manager and first-round interviewer for roles on the team.

- Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates with the right mix of billing-domain depth and engineering judgment.

- Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery, Roadmap & Partnerships

- Own the Billing roadmap and project management in Linear, driving accountability, clear milestones, and predictable delivery.

- Balance new pricing and product capabilities with investments in system correctness, resilience, supportability, and technical debt.

- Manage workflow intake and Slack triage, deciding what should be routed, prioritized, sequenced, or pushed back on.

- Own weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating unnecessary overhead.

- Surface risks, dependencies, tradeoffs, and revenue or customer-impact concerns early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

- Train as an Incident Commander and lead coordination, resolution, customer-impact assessment, and post-incident follow-up.

- Lead blameless post-incident reviews.

YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

- Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

- Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

- Have managed a billing engineering team at a cloud, SaaS, or developer tools company. Experience with developer tools or databases is a strong preference, but we'll consider any sufficiently technical background where you can demonstrate the ability to ramp on a new domain.

- Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

- Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

title: Broadcasting Coach
description:
Leland is building the home for ambition in the age of AI. We connect people with the experts, programs, and communities they need to land the job, get into the school, or upskill for a world being rewritten by AI. We help businesses become AI-native through training, hiring, and infrastructure. Since our founding in 2021, we've helped tens of thousands of people reach their most ambitious goals and raised $19M from world-class investors. Ambition is sacred to us, and we've built a product that takes that seriously.
We're seeking an experienced Broadcasting Coach to work with clients looking to break into or grow within the broadcasting and news industry. This role includes teaching core broadcasting techniques, on-air presentation, and script writing, as well as helping clients strengthen their news reporting and video editing skills. Coaches also support clients on the career side, offering resume review and interview prep tailored to broadcasting roles, along with guidance on networking strategy and salary negotiation. Additional support includes skill building for on-camera and behind-the-scenes work, as well as guidance for those pursuing freelancing opportunities in the industry. Ideal candidates have hands-on experience in broadcasting or journalism (as an on-air talent, producer, reporter, or industry professional), a strong understanding of what it takes to succeed on-air and behind the scenes, and a clear, structured approach to coaching clients through both technical and career growth. Coaches set their own hours and rates, host sessions virtually, and partner with our team to deliver a high-quality, supportive experience for every client.
Why Leland ?

• The chance to join a world-class team helping people achieve their career and educational dreams

• Work in a collaborative, high-energy environment where your contributions have a direct impact

• Operate in a fast-paced, AI-native environment

• We don't hire people who merely want to work for a great company; we hire people who want to make a great company

Leland is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage candidates of all backgrounds and demographics to apply.

title: Patient Sales & Lead Conversion Specialist | Colombia
description:
About Us
HireHawk connects skilled professionals with high-quality remote career opportunities at U.S. and Canadian companies, with team members working across the Philippines, Latin America, South Africa, Europe, and beyond. We believe great people should be able to do meaningful work from anywhere, with clear expectations, strong support, and an outcomes-first culture.
For this opportunity, you will support a high-touch Beverly Hills cosmetic surgery practice where patient experience begins from the very first inquiry.
About the Role
You will own a critical part of the inbound patient journey: responding quickly to new inquiries, building trust, booking consultations, and staying meaningfully engaged with prospective patients who are not ready to move forward immediately. The practice receives approximately 15-20 new leads per day, primarily through organic social content and Meta, so speed and consistent follow-up directly affect patient conversion.
After-hours and weekend responsiveness is especially important so prospective patients are not left waiting overnight or through the weekend.
Responsibilities

• Own the inbound patient lead pipeline and respond to new inquiries with a strong sense of urgency across phone, text, and email.

• Turn qualified interest into booked consultations by building trust, answering appropriate questions, and confidently guiding prospects toward the next step.

• Follow up consistently with prospects who do not book immediately, using useful and personalized communication rather than repetitive booking requests.

• Build longer-term nurture relationships with prospective patients who are interested but need more time before scheduling.

• Maintain a polished, reassuring phone presence when speaking with affluent and high-expectation prospective patients.

• Qualify incoming leads and identify where each prospective patient is in their decision-making process.

• Keep every patient interaction, follow-up, status change, and next step accurately documented in the practice CRM.

• Provide after-hours and weekend lead coverage so new inquiries receive a fast response even when the core practice team is unavailable.

• Support prospective patients after their consultation when needed as they consider moving forward with surgery.

Requirements

Must-Have:

• 2-4+ years of experience in inbound sales, patient coordination, appointment setting, lead conversion, medical or aesthetic sales, or another high-touch consumer sales environment.

• Excellent spoken and written English with a polished, professional communication style.

• Strong phone confidence and experience making and receiving customer- or patient-facing calls.

• Proven ability to convert inbound interest into appointments or consultations through timely, persistent follow-up.

• Experience managing leads across phone, email, and SMS while keeping accurate CRM records.

• High emotional intelligence with the ability to establish trust quickly and communicate confidently without sounding pushy.

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment while maintaining exceptional responsiveness, organization, and follow-through.

Nice to Have:

• Previous experience in plastic surgery, cosmetic surgery, a med spa, aesthetics, or another elective medical service environment.

• Experience coordinating patients within a medical practice.

• Experience selling or coordinating high-ticket elective services to discerning or high-expectation consumers.

• Familiarity with Meta or Instagram-generated leads and tools such as ManyChat.

• Familiarity with the practice's CRM platform.

A high school diploma is required. A college degree is welcomed but is not required for a strong candidate with relevant experience.

Loft Orbital's mission is to make space simple. We deploy customer missions on our satellite infrastructure so our customers can focus on their applications instead of the spacecraft underneath them. The Customer Delivery team turns signed contracts into working missions on orbit and supports our customers from start to finish.
As a Technical Program Manager, Customer Delivery, you maintain the engine that drives the Customer Delivery team forward. Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple. 

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

title: CENTRALE LYON - PhD Silicon Photonics for Scalable Energy-Efficient AI Hardware Accelerators
tags: INL - Institut des Nanotechnologies de Lyon
description: The rapid expansion of artificial intelligence (AI) applications across cloud and edge environments is driving the need for highly efficient hardware capable of supporting increasingly demanding workloads. Among these, matrix multiplication - particularly General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) - remains the dominant computational kernel in modern AI models, including deep neural networks and transformer architectures. Conventional electronic accelerators, while highly optimized, face growing challenges related to energy consumption, data movement, and scalability. Silicon photonics has emerged as a promising technology to address these limitations by enabling highbandwidth, low-latency, and potentially energy-efficient computation through optical signal processing. In particular, recent advances in photonic computing leveraging phase-change materials (PCM) offer new opportunities for implementing reconfigurable and non-volatile computational primitives directly in the optical domain. This PhD is part of the CAMELIA program (ASIC and Numérique agencies) within the targeted project LEAF, and aims to explore a hybrid photonic-electronic computing paradigm for AI acceleration. The central objective is to design and evaluate silicon photonics-based architectures for efficient GEMM operations, building on recent work demonstrating a reconfigurable photonic GEMM architecture based on PCM and stochastic computing. The proposed research will focus on extending this tile-based photonic GEMM approach toward large-scale matrix operations under realistic conditions. Key challenges include managing PCM-related constraints such as limited precision and quantization effects, mitigating noise and variability, and addressing interface latency between photonic and electronic domains. We’re hiring a Team Leader for our Brighton-based Seller Sales team. This is a rare opportunity to join an established operation with a strong track record, but where we’re now ready to raise the bar. You’ll be responsible for leading a team of Sales Agents, supporting daily performance, and driving continuous improvement through effective coaching, motivation and management oversight.

We’re looking for a confident, hands-on people manager who knows how to get the best out of a sales team. This role is not a stepping stone into people leadership - it’s designed for someone who already has the fundamentals and is hungry for a bigger challenge. You’ll bring energy, accountability and a strong coaching ethos, helping us build a high-performance culture and set the standard for the future.

What You'll Be Doing

- Own the day-to-day running of a high-performing sales team - a team of up to 14 Contact Centre agents

- Drive individual and team performance against a range of KPIs

- Coach regularly and effectively to build skill, resilience and accountability

- Use data and dashboards to manage the team - spot trends, address issues, share insights

- Deliver 1-2-1s, performance reviews and development plans that have real impact

- Manage attendance, adherence and wellbeing in a fair, visible way

- Collaborate cross functionally to drive improved business outcomes

- Bring energy and creativity to drive motivation and results

- Take ownership of issues, initiatives and working practices

- Work as effectively and collaboratively part of a broader management team

About You

- Proven experience as a Sales Team Leader in a contact centre or fast-paced sales environment

- Comfortable leading from the front and holding people accountable

- Strong coaching mindset - knows how to build capability

- Resilient and action-oriented - works at pace and keeps things moving

- Good commercial understanding of how contact centre sales performance links to wider business goals

- A data-literate operator who can use insights to make better decisions

- Positive, driven, and able to influence others across teams

You'll Thrive Here If

- You want to make your mark on an established team

- You value ownership, autonomy and trust

- You believe that coaching is more than a buzzword

- You like being in the thick of it - making decisions, solving problems and leading from the front

- You want a role with clear potential to develop further

- Initial Screen - 30 minutes

- Hiring Manager Interview - 60 minutes

- Written task

Monday to Friday - 8:45am to 5:30pm

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

title: Scriptwriter - Storyby
Post-doctorante ou Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux - CDD de 18 mois
description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.
La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en transmission et détection sur fibres à cœurs creux pour rejoindre le département COMELEC à Télécom Paris.
Les fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (Hollow-Core Photonic Crystal Fibers, HCPCF) ont récemment franchi une étape technologique majeure, avec des pertes de propagation pouvant atteindre 0.1 dB/km à 1550 nm, comparables, voire inférieures, à celles des fibres télécoms standards [1-2]. La lumière se propageant principalement dans l’air, les HCPCF présentent une latence réduite de 30 à 40 %, une dispersion ultra-faible et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables. Ces propriétés uniques en font des technologies particulièrement prometteuses pour les systèmes de télécommunications de nouvelle génération, la distribution quantique de clés (Quantum Key Distribution, QKD) sur longue distance et les applications de détection distribuée.
Le projet proposé vise à développer et démontrer la prochaine génération de fibres à cristaux photoniques à cœur creux (HCPCF) pour la transmission de données à haut débit et les applications de détection. La propagation de la lumière dans l’air plutôt que dans le verre permet aux HCPCF d’offrir une latence réduite et des non-linéarités optiques négligeables par rapport aux fibres de silice, répondant ainsi à certains des enjeux majeurs des futurs centres de données et réseaux optiques. Notre ambition est de démontrer une transmission à 400 Gbit/s sur quelques kilomètres à travers des échantillons de fibres issus de nouvelles architectures, et d’étudier le potentiel de ces HCPCF pour des applications de détection. La réalisation de ces objectifs nécessite de répondre à des spécifications exigeantes en matière de guidage monomode, de contrôle de la polarisation, ainsi que de faibles pertes par courbure et par couplage.
Deux équipes complémentaires assureront conjointement l'encadrement de ces travaux : le GPPMM, reconnu internationalement pour ses activités de conception et de fabrication de HCPCF [3-5], et le GTO, leader dans la démonstration de systèmes de communication optique et de détection à haut débit [6-8]. Un processus itératif entre la fabrication des fibres et leur caractérisation au niveau système permettra de s'assurer que leurs propriétés répondent aux exigences opérationnelles en matière de transmission et de détection. Sur le plan méthodologique, le projet combinera modélisation numérique, caractérisation et validation expérimentale dans la bande C. Les méthodes de modélisation et de traitement du signal développées au GTO pour le suivi de la polarisation contribueront à évaluer et à optimiser les performances de transmission des HCPCF conçues et caractérisées au GPPMM.
À propos du projet PLEIADES
Le projet PLEIADES s'inscrit dans le cadre du programme PEPR « Réseaux du futur », financé par l'ANR, et réunit un consortium de 14 partenaires. L'un des axes de travail porte sur les fibres à cœur creux de nouvelle génération et rassemble plusieurs laboratoires académiques, notamment LTCI, XLIM et PHLAM.

Vos principales missions seront de :

• Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de la photonique

• Assurer des missions d’encadrement et de tutorat

• Participer à la notoriété de l’Ecole, de l’Institut Mines-Télécom et de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris

We are looking to expand our software engineers, seeking those with deep rooted entrepreneurial spirit.
Our serverless platform is a multi-tenant monorepo - Next.js and React on the front, tRPC and Prisma behind it, deployed on SST, TypeScript throughout. One engineer can follow a change from a form field to the database without crossing a team boundary. That's the point.
Engineering at Bask Health is AI-first and builder-led. Work starts with general understanding of problem, moves to tools like Claude and Cursor for further investigation, making a plan and building, tested on staging with realistic data, released to production, tested with real patient and care teams, and then back for systems and polish. AI is a default part of how we work, not a side experiment - because moving fast in healthcare requires every advantage.

•
Design, build, and ship high-quality product experiences. Own key surfaces end to end, from concept through production. Write elegant, well-tested code - we have a real test suite and we intend to keep it that way.

•
Work across the stack. Follow a feature from the interface through the API to the database. No handoffs, no waiting on another team.

•
Work AI-first with Cursor and Claude Code. Use LLMs as your starting point. Draft intent, explore implementations, scaffold components, and refactor with AI in the loop. Apply your own judgment to meet the quality bar healthcare demands.

•
Prototype fast and validate with real users. Build and test quickly with real patients and care teams. Use what you learn to refine before fully committing - especially in sensitive clinical contexts where getting it right matters.

Build for scale and own the codebase. Translate product needs into reusable, well-architected patterns that make the next feature faster to ship.

•
Share AI-native workflows. Document prompts, patterns, and workflows that work, so we move faster together without cutting corners that matter to patient outcomes.

We are a highly collaborative team.

At Databricks, we are passionate about helping data teams solve the world's toughest problems,  from making the next mode of transportation a reality to accelerating the development of medical breakthroughs. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

Anduril's ArsenalOS team builds the digital infrastructure that powers how Anduril designs, sources, manufactures, delivers, and sustains hardware at scale. We are not a traditional internal IT organization. We build, buy, customize, integrate, and operate the systems that make Anduril's physical operations faster, more reliable, and more scalable.

ABOUT THE JOB:

We are hiring a Staff Product Manager for Sustainment Solutions to own the digital portfolio that keeps Anduril's fielded systems mission-ready: operations planning, fleet management, maintenance execution, and customer support. This role turns a rapidly scaling, high-complexity sustainment mission into a durable operating advantage. You will own the roadmap, operating model, stakeholder relationships, and execution strategy for systems including our sustainment planning engine, fleet management and reliability tooling (asset tracking and FRACAS), field maintenance execution, and the customer service desk and portal. • Create durable mechanisms for intake, prioritization, roadmap management, and stakeholder alignment without turning the org into a slow process machine.

description:
Licensed Professional Counselor (LPC) $62 K-80K/yr

Position Requirement: Remote Full-Time and Part-time Positions Available

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

• Starting Salary range: $62,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year.

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Health care benefits.

• Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

• Customized schedules within available clinic hours.

• Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).

• Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.

• Incredible administrative support team.

• Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.

title: Founding Head of Brand
description:
We are hiring a Founding Head of Brand to own how Pairs presents itself to founders and investors: its positioning, voice and visual identity, and the writing and video behind them.

Pairs is a global network of family offices, institutional investors, VCs and angels. We screen deal flow very tightly, and the opportunities that clear our diligence go out to the network. We invest alongside them too.

THE ROLE

This is our first full-time brand hire. You set the brand strategy and you run it: what Pairs says, where it says it, how it looks, and the impression a founder or investor forms before they ever speak to us.

Most weeks, that means one or two high-value posts in the founders' voices and one or two from the company. You also run story shoots with the founders and investors we work with, from booking the guest to the final cut, and you edit the video yourself.

We already hold a library of recorded founder and investor interviews. A large part of this role is turning that material into content people want to watch, and finding creative new ways to use it: films, series, clips and formats we have not tried yet.

You also own our editorial output: a weekly newsletter that also lives on our site, a monthly newsletter, and a quarterly report we want to become a reference point for the market.

Everything is aimed at one outcome: how founders and investors perceive Pairs. Every post, film and report should reinforce a brand they trust before the first conversation.

You report to the two co-founders, shape the strategy with them directly, and have real creative freedom. You will make the work yourself from day one, and build a team around you as the brand grows.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- Brand identity. Positioning, voice and visual identity, held consistent across our site, our social channels and the press.

- Editorial and social. Weekly founder and company posts on LinkedIn and X, both newsletters and the quarterly report. You write them and you publish them.

- Our video library. Repurposing recorded founder and investor interviews into films, series and clips, and finding creative new ways to use the material.

- Story shoots. New founder and investor shoots, from booking and preparation through the shoot to the final edit, which you cut yourself.

- Brand perception. How founders and investors perceive Pairs, and how that perception improves over time.

YOU ARE A FIT IF YOU

- Have built and run a brand end to end that we can review: a named brand where you set the voice, created the content, ran the channels, and can quote the results before and after.

- Still create the work yourself. You write, edit video and direct shoots, and you can state precisely what you made and what you briefed out.

- See more in existing footage than others do: new formats, series and cuts that give recorded material a second life.

- Write to a high standard in a restrained register, with published work longer than a social caption.

- Have managed people who make the work, whether a small team or freelancers, and are ready to build a team here over time.

- Use AI tools daily, with clear judgement about where they improve your work and where they would compromise its quality.

Familiarity with the founder and venture capital world is a strong advantage, but not a requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Fully remote and asynchronous, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time each day

- Direct access to the co-founders, and real creative freedom

- A library of recorded founder and investor interviews ready to edit, and a video team already in place

- The room to build a team around you as the brand grows

- The best AI tools, paid for

- A brand that is yours to build and run

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role:

Large teams of agents are starting to solve problems no single agent can, from rewriting major codebases to formalizing landmark mathematics. Our team studies how these teams scale: what happens to performance, cost and coordination as the number of agents, the compute budget and the length of the task grow, and what has to change to keep getting returns from that scale. We build the platform and evaluations Anthropic uses to run and measure large agent teams, and other research teams build on them.

This role lives at the boundary between research and engineering. It is a generalist role on a small team: you'll design and run large experiments, build the systems they run on, and get to the bottom of surprising results. We often need to go from a vague question to a running experiment quickly.

Responsibilities:

• Design, run and interpret large-scale experiments on agent teams, reasoning rigorously about what the data does and doesn't show

• Investigate how performance and efficiency change as team size, compute and task horizon grow, and find the bottlenecks that limit them

• Build and scale the systems that run very large agent teams reliably, and debug the failures that only appear at scale

• Design evaluations for long-horizon problems, and keep their results trustworthy

• Build the tooling and metrics that let researchers see what a large agent team is doing and why

• Partner with research teams across Anthropic so they can run their own experiments on the platform, and communicate findings clearly

You may be a good fit if you:

• Have significant software engineering, ML or research engineering experience

• Have owned something substantial end to end, such as a large system, an evaluation or benchmark, an agent product, or a research project

• Genuinely enjoy both research and engineering work

• Think quantitatively about complex systems, and think twice before trusting a number

• Can work from a vague question rather than a spec

• Are results-oriented, with a bias towards flexibility and impact

• Have clear written and verbal communication

• Care about the societal impacts of your work

Strong candidates may also have:

• Experience building or operating large-scale distributed systems, such as schedulers, sandboxed code execution, or inference and RL infrastructure

• Built evaluations, benchmarks or harnesses for LLMs or agents

• Experience building complex agentic systems that use LLMs

• Experience with scaling laws or other large-scale empirical research

• A background in operations research, statistics, economics, physics, quantitative finance, or another field that models and optimizes complex systems

Strong candidates need not have:

• Formal certifications or education credentials

• Academic research experience or publication history

• Prior experience with multi-agent systems or reinforcement learning

Representative projects:

• Measure how performance scales with the number of agents on a hard problem, and explain where the curve bends and why

• Prepare our largest-ever agent run: find what breaks as team size and task length grow together, and fix it before launch

• Work out how to allocate a fixed compute budget across a team of agents to solve a problem fastest

• Build tooling that turns the activity of a large agent team into something a researcher can read in minutes

• Design a novel eval that distinguishes real gains in teamwork from artifacts of the evaluation setup

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
Solvd Inc. is a rapidly growing AI-native consulting and technology services firm delivering enterprise transformation across cloud, data, software engineering, and artificial intelligence. We work with industry-leading organizations to design, build, and operationalize technology solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.

Following the acquisition of Tooploox, a premier AI and product development company, Solvd now offers true end-to-end delivery-from strategic advisory and solution design to custom AI development and enterprise-scale implementation. Our capability centers combine deep technical expertise, proven delivery methodologies, and sector-specific knowledge to address complex business challenges quickly and effectively.

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to replace a manual, per-customer release process with real CI/CD, and to build the infrastructure and observability layer underneath a platform migration moving from a single-tenant-built, multi-tenant-operated model to a genuinely self-serve one.

This role is the reason the other roles on this engagement can move fast. Right now, standing up a new customer means someone manually editing a spreadsheet of build variables, committing, and running a pipeline by hand. You're the one who turns that into something that doesn't need a person in the loop.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Redesign the current manual, per-customer release pipeline into an automated, parameterized CI/CD pipeline that a provisioning event can trigger directly - no manual pipeline run or spreadsheet edit required.

- Build and operate secrets-management infrastructure - vaulting, per-tenant scoping, rotation schedules - that the backend credential-issuance service runs on top of.

- Own infrastructure-as-code for all services being built as part of this migration - provisioning APIs, configuration services, admin console - across dev, staging, and production environments, with consistent and reproducible builds.

- Build monitoring and alerting for a distributed, endpoint-heavy system with known failure modes - stale proxy detection, retry storms, unbounded local queue growth - turning silent failures into pages before customers report them.

- Maintain build and release tooling for multi-platform client software, making platform-specific configuration differences visible and manageable rather than a source of drift.

- Tighten access controls, logging, and distribution for production configuration tooling as part of the broader security posture of the release process.

REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

- 5+ years in a DevOps, platform engineering, or SRE role with real ownership of a CI/CD pipeline for a production system - not just consuming someone else's pipeline.

- Hands-on experience with secrets management - designing rotation schedules and per-tenant/per-environment scoping, not just storing static values.

- Infrastructure-as-code experience with Terraform or equivalent for standing up and managing multiple environments consistently.

- Experience building observability - metrics, logging, alerting - for distributed systems with many independent, loosely-connected clients.

- Comfortable working with multi-platform build pipelines across at least two operating systems, including packaging and signing requirements.

- Security-conscious by default - this role directly replaces a process that bakes shared secrets into distributed software; access control needs to be a standing question, not an afterthought.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

- Experience turning a manual, human-run release process into a fully automated one as a scoped project - not just incremental pipeline improvements.

- Experience operating infrastructure for a self-serve, marketplace-distributed SaaS product.

- Familiarity with cloud data platform deployment models - warehouse-adjacent compute or native application distribution.

title: Campaign Specialist, QA
description:
About Integrate

Integrate is a B2B demand orchestration platform that helps enterprise marketing teams capture, validate, and activate leads across every channel - turning fragmented demand generation into a unified, measurable pipeline.

As a Campaign Specialist, QA you will conduct rigorous QA reviews on campaign deliverables to ensure consistency, compliance, and alignment with requirements. Reporting via a dotted line to a designated Team Lead, you will identify deviations, maintain trackers, provide weekly analyses, and support Team Lead responsibilities including SOP creation/updates under Manager/Lead supervision. This role focuses on driving process excellence, error reduction, and optimization across multi-channel campaigns, collaborating with clients, sales, and execution teams to uphold Integrate 's standards for lead quality and platform reliability.

Key Responsibilities

• Conduct comprehensive QA reviews for campaign deliverables (e.g., creative assets, targeting setups, compliance checklists), ensuring consistency with campaign requirements and standards.

• Identify and document process and output deviations from quality standards, recommending optimizations, automation opportunities, or corrective actions.

• Maintain QA trackers and audit data to identify gaps, trends, and insights; deliver weekly analysis reports to Team Lead and relevant stakeholders.

• Support Team Lead with responsibilities such as error-tracking, check-ins, bandwidth monitoring, and task prioritization through QA-driven insights.

• Assist with SOP creation, updates, and documentation under Manager/Team Lead supervision to standardize workflows and reduce errors.

• Collaborate with Campaign Specialists, clients, and sales teams to resolve QA issues, validate fixes, and ensure seamless campaign launches.

• Monitor multi-channel campaign outputs for compliance (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and performance benchmarks, flagging risks proactively.

• Contribute to process automation initiatives by testing tools and providing feedback on QA-impacting features.

• Perform ad-hoc audits, root-cause analyses, and support team training on quality standards.

· Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

•
2+ years of experience in quality assurance, campaign review, or process auditing within a SaaS, marketing technology, or B2B lead generation environment.

• Strong attention to detail with proven ability to identify deviations, document findings, and suggest actionable optimizations.

• Experience maintaining trackers, dashboards, and delivering regular analysis reports (e.g., weekly summaries).

• Familiarity with multi-channel campaign workflows, compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, CCPA), and tools like Salesforce, Google Sheets/Excel, or QA platforms.

• Collaborative mindset with ability to support Team Lead duties in a dotted-line structure under Manager supervision.

• Analytical skills to audit data, spot trends, and recommend SOP/process improvements.

• Excellent documentation and communication skills for clear reporting to stakeholders.

• Proficiency in process mapping and SOP development.

• Thrives in fast-paced, matrixed teams focused on operational excellence.

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Quality Management, or related field preferred.

Applied Intuition is headquartered in Sunnyvale, California, with offices in Washington, D.C.; San Diego; Ft. Walton Beach, Florida; Ann Arbor, Michigan; London; Stuttgart; Munich; Stockholm; Bangalore; Seoul; and Tokyo. Learn more at applied.co http://applied.co.

We are an in-office company, and our expectation is that full-time employees primarily work from their Applied Intuition office 5 days a week. However, we also recognize the importance of flexibility and trust our employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work, starting the day with morning meetings from home before heading to the office, or leaving earlier when needed to accommodate family commitments. This in-office expectation does not apply to contractor positions

About the Role

Applied Intuition builds and deploys autonomous systems across automotive, trucking, and industrials programs. As we scale, we need one company standard: consistent procedures, consistent records, and evidence we can put in front of any customer or regulator, in any program.

This role owns that standard. You will build and run the operational safety compliance and assurance framework across every program - procedures, incident classification, compliance obligations, and the records that evidence all of it.

This is a cross-program mandate, not a program-embedded one. Individual programs will continue to execute; your job is to make sure they execute against the same standard and can prove it.

At Applied Intuition, you will:

- Establish a unified operational framework across automotive, trucking, and industrials, including SOPs, readiness checklists, and incident taxonomy.

- Own the operational safety ownership map, identifying responsibilities, gaps, and cross-functional dependencies.

- Develop and maintain safety-driven operational procedures in partnership with Systems Engineering and Program Management.

- Represent Operations in change control and deployment readiness reviews, ensuring execution readiness.

- Own the operational compliance framework, including permits, authorizations, customer obligations, audits, and regulatory changes.

- Ensure fleet compliance requirements are met and documented, including inspections, maintenance, safety-critical parts, defect containment, and DOT drug/alcohol testing.

- Own incident management end to end, from classification and response through RCA, CAPA, and verified effectiveness.

- Drive cross-program incident and safety trend analysis, ensuring lessons learned reach all field teams.

- Define and maintain operational safety evidence, support safety cases and customer assurances, and report safety performance to leadership.

 

We're looking for someone who has:

- 7+ years of experience in operational compliance, transportation safety, program management, or a related field, including 3+ years in a safety-critical or regulated environment.

- Proven ownership of compliance programs, including building and maintaining the underlying framework.

- Experience standardizing processes across multiple programs, sites, or business units.

- Strong experience with root cause analysis and CAPA through verified closure.

- Proven ability to build audit-ready documentation and recordkeeping systems.

- Excellent written communication, with the ability to create clear operator procedures and concise executive-level sum

The Market Groups apply a regional lens, ensuring that our agile and adaptable capabilities remain aligned to the wicked problems that matter most to our partners across the Americas, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific.

Group Overview

Air Mobility Group (AIRMOB) is responsible for developing and delivering Metrea’s aerial refueling (AAR) capabilities, ensuring the readiness and operational effectiveness of the tanker fleet. AIRMOB oversees fleet management, maintenance, and airworthiness, working to sustain and enhance refueling operations. It manages the integration of new processes and technologies, ensuring that tanker aircraft remain mission-ready through effective logistics, maintenance oversight, and regulatory compliance. By coordinating across various teams, AIRMOB ensures the fleet meets both current and future operational needs, supporting a range of specialized air mobility missions.

Position Summary

In this role, you will maintain the accuracy and integrity of aircraft maintenance records for AIRMOB’s aerial refueling fleet, ensuring every maintenance event is properly documented in AMOS and compliant with FAA requirements. You will handle daily records processing, data entry, document control, and filing while supporting the Records Manager in audits and quality reviews. You will be successful if you are organized, detail-focused, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, compliance-driven environment where accuracy directly supports fleet airworthiness.

What You'll Do

• Enter maintenance work orders, log cards, and inspection records into AMOS on a daily basis

• Review maintenance documentation for completeness and accuracy before system entry

• Scan, index, and file technical records in both electronic and hard-copy filing systems

• Maintain deferred defect logs and MEL tracking documentation

• Research historical records to support maintenance planning and troubleshooting

• Generate routine AMOS reports including aircraft status and compliance summaries

• Coordinate with maintenance technicians to resolve documentation discrepancies
